searchAgreement.select: select a.agrmnt_id AS "AgrmntId", a.agrmnt_no AS "AgrmntNo", a.agrmnt_dt AS "AgrmntDt", d.full_name AS "DebtorName", a.ntf_amt AS "NtfAmt", a.tenor AS "Tenor", a.contract_stat AS "ContractStat"
searchAgreement.from: from agrmnt a left join debtor d on a.debtor_id = d.debtor_id

searchPendingAgreement.select: select a.agrmnt_id AS "AgrmntId", a.agrmnt_no AS "AgrmntNo", d.full_name AS "DebtorName", a.ntf_amt AS "NtfAmt", a.tenor AS "Tenor", a.contract_stat AS "ContractStat"
searchPendingAgreement.from: from agrmnt a left join debtor d on a.debtor_id = d.debtor_id

searchActiveAgreement.select: select a.agrmnt_id AS "AgrmntId", a.agrmnt_no AS "AgrmntNo", d.full_name AS "DebtorName", a.agrmnt_dt AS "AgrmntDt", a.inst_amt AS "InstAmt", sub.next_due_dt AS "NextDueDt"
searchActiveAgreement.from: from agrmnt a left join debtor d on a.debtor_id = d.debtor_id cross join (select business_dt from business_dt order by business_dt_id desc limit 1) b cross join lateral (select min(s.inst_due_dt) as next_due_dt from inst_schdl s where s.agrmnt_id = a.agrmnt_id and s.inst_paid_amt < s.inst_amt) sub
searchActiveAgreement.where: where a.contract_stat = 'LIVE' and sub.next_due_dt is not null and b.business_dt <= (sub.next_due_dt + a.grace_period)

searchOverdueAgreement.select: select a.agrmnt_id AS "AgrmntId", a.agrmnt_no AS "AgrmntNo", d.full_name AS "DebtorName", a.agrmnt_dt AS "AgrmntDt", a.inst_amt AS "InstAmt", sub.next_due_dt AS "NextDueDt"
searchOverdueAgreement.from: from agrmnt a left join debtor d on a.debtor_id = d.debtor_id cross join (select business_dt from business_dt order by business_dt_id desc limit 1) b cross join lateral (select min(s.inst_due_dt) as next_due_dt from inst_schdl s where s.agrmnt_id = a.agrmnt_id and s.inst_paid_amt < s.inst_amt) sub
searchOverdueAgreement.where: where a.contract_stat = 'LIVE' and sub.next_due_dt is not null and b.business_dt > (sub.next_due_dt + a.grace_period)

Lookup_asset_master.select: select r.ref_asset_master_id AS "RefAssetMasterId", r.asset_name AS "AssetName", r.asset_category AS "AssetCategory", r.asset_price AS "AssetPrice", r.is_active AS "IsActive"

Lookup_sales_person.select: select s.sales_person_id AS "SalesPersonId", s.sales_code AS "SalesCode", s.sales_name AS "SalesName", s.position AS "Position", s.phone_number AS "PhoneNumber"
